{{short description|1563 book on cryptography}}
{{italic title}}
'''''De Furtivis Literarum Notis''''' (''On the Secret Symbols of Letters'') is a 1563 book on [[cryptography]] written by [[Giambattista della Porta]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Keeping secrets in sixteenth-century Istanbul |url=https://blog.oup.com/2017/08/sixteenth-century-spies-istanbul/ |website=OUPblog |accessdate=23 September 2020 |language=en |date=22 August 2017}}</ref>

The book includes three sets of cypher discs for coding and decoding messages,<ref>{{cite web |title=On Secret Writing |url=https://galileo.ou.edu/exhibits/secret-writing |website=University of Oklahoma |accessdate=23 September 2020 |language=en |date=23 June 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title="The Author And His Work" Giambattista della Porta (JOHN BAPTIST PORTA) |url=https://www.faculty.umb.edu/gary_zabel/Courses/Phil%20281b/Philosophy%20of%20Magic/Natural_Magic/jportat3.html |website=University of Massachusetts Boston |accessdate=23 September 2020}}</ref> a [[substitution cipher]] improving on the work of [[Al-Qalqashandi]],<ref>{{cite web |title=Giovanni della Porta, el sabio renacentista que encriptaba mensajes dentro de huevos para eludir el control de la Inquisición |url=https://www.labrujulaverde.com/2019/03/giovanni-della-porta-el-sabio-renacentista-que-encriptaba-mensajes-dentro-de-huevos-para-eludir-el-control-de-la-inquisicion |website=La Brújula Verde |accessdate=23 September 2020 |language=es |date=1 March 2019}}</ref> and one of the earliest known [[Music cipher#porta|music substitution cipher]]s.
